About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

 

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, Galaxy Ventures, FirstMark, Lightspeed, Norwest, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

 

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the Role

Rain is looking for a Business Development Lead to build and scale our presence in the rapidly emerging agentic commerce ecosystem.

You’ll drive new business by identifying high-value opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, and building a strong commercial pipeline. You’ll also help shape Rain’s commercial thesis at the intersection of stablecoins and AI, identifying where our infrastructure can unlock new use cases and where Rain has a right to win.

Working closely with Product and Engineering, you’ll translate market insights into commercial and product opportunities and position Rain as a critical infrastructure partner for the next generation of commerce.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role for someone who can see where the market is headed, move early, and turn emerging opportunities into meaningful growth for Rain.

What You’ll Do

  • Build Rain’s agentic commerce pipeline: Identify, source, and develop high-value commercial opportunities across AI-native companies, agent platforms, agentic commerce infrastructure providers, and emerging payment ecosystems.

  • Develop our agentic commerce strategy: Define priority segments, use cases, target accounts, and partnership opportunities, with a particular focus on where stablecoin and payments infrastructure can unlock new capabilities for AI-powered commerce.

  • Drive commercial execution: Develop compelling value propositions, manage a high-quality pipeline, and work cross-functionally to convert opportunities into long-term partnerships.

  • Stay ahead of the market: Identify emerging trends, technologies, companies, and use cases across AI and payments early, and translate them into commercial opportunities and strategic priorities for Rain.

  • Own strategic partnerships: Lead opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through solutioning, negotiation, deal execution, and handoff.

  • Build the ecosystem: Establish relationships with founders, developers, and industry leaders shaping the future of AI-powered commerce and autonomous payments.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering: Bring market intelligence and prospective partner feedback into product discussions, helping inform Rain’s roadmap and identify opportunities for new capabilities.

  • Shape Rain’s market position: Develop our point of view on the role of stablecoins in agentic commerce and build Rain’s position as a leading infrastructure partner in the ecosystem.

What We’re Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in business development, strategic partnerships, or a related commercial role, ideally within AI, fintech, payments, or emerging technology.

  • Strong understanding of the AI ecosystem, particularly agentic commerce, AI agents, and the infrastructure enabling autonomous transactions.

  • Demonstrated ability to source, develop, negotiate, and close strategic commercial partnerships.

  • Entrepreneurial mindset with experience building new business opportunities end to end, entering emerging markets, or developing go-to-market strategies from the ground up.

  • Strong commercial judgment and the ability to identify high-potential opportunities in rapidly evolving markets.

  • Ability to form an independent point of view on emerging markets and translate it into commercial action.

  • Ability to engage credibly with both technical and business stakeholders, translating complex technologies into clear commercial value propositions.

  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

  • High degree of ownership, intellectual curiosity, and bias toward action.

  • Comfortable operating independently in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities and limited established playbooks.

Nice to Have

  • Direct experience working at an AI-native company, agentic commerce platform, or AI infrastructure provider.

  • Existing relationships within the AI developer, agentic commerce, or emerging payments ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with AI agent frameworks, agent payment protocols, and emerging standards for autonomous transactions.

  • Experience with payments infrastructure, card issuing, stablecoins, wallets, or blockchain-based financial services.

  • Track record of building and scaling a new commercial vertical or ecosystem partnership strategy.

Things that enable a fulfilling, healthy and happy experience at Rain:

Unlimited time off 🌴Unlimited vacation can be daunting, so we require Rainmakers to take 10 days minimum for themselves.

Flexible working ☕ We support a flexible workplace, if you feel comfortable at home please work from home. If you’d like to work with others in an office feel free to come in. We want everyone to be able to work in the environment in which they are their most confident and productive selves. New Rainmakers will have a stipend to create a comfortable atmosphere at home.

Easy to access benefits 🧠For US Rainmakers, we offer comprehensive health, dental and vision plans for you and your dependents, as well as a 100% company subsidized life insurance plan.

Retirement goals💡Plan for the future with confidence. We offer a 401(k) with a 4% company match.

Equity plan 📦 We offer every Rainmakers an equity option plan so we can all can benefit from our success.

Rain Cards 🌧️ We want Rainmakers to be knowledgeable about our core products and services. To support this mission, we issue a card for our team to utilize the card for testing.

Health and Wellness 📚 High performance begins from within. Rainmakers are welcome to use their card for eligible health and wellness spending like gym memberships/fitness classes, massages, acupuncture - whatever recharges you!

Team summits ✨ Summits play an important role at Rain! Time spent together helps us get to know each other, strengthen our relationships, and build a common destiny. Expect team and company offsites both domestically and internationally.

Innovation Quant Developer: Intern - DeFi/Corporate Development

Since 2017, Keyrock has been a change-maker in digital assets. We're a global, remote-first team of 200+ people across 40+ nationalities, with hubs in Brussels, London, Paris and New York.

 

We provide liquidity across 80+ centralized and decentralized exchanges - a position cemented by our Series C, led by SC Ventures. Today we run a full spectrum of capital markets businesses across centralized and on-chain venues: market making, high-frequency trading, options, OTC, DeFi trading desks, advisory, and asset management.

 

We're building toward the agentic investment banking capabilities for the era of digital finance. A proprietary agentic layer runs the mechanics of the market, so our people can focus on the work code cannot do: the deal, the relationship, and the judgement.

We're not just envisioning the future of finance - we're building it.

About the Internship Program

Our internship programme gives early-career talent the opportunity to build practical skills, contribute to meaningful projects and learn alongside experienced colleagues in digital finance.

Typically lasting six months and based in our Brussels office (London possible), each internship includes hands-on experience, clear learning goals and dedicated guidance and regular feedback. We look for curiosity, relevant foundational skills, deep, active interest and passion for digital assets and the potential to grow exponentially with us - you don’t need to arrive with all the answers. Where performance, business needs and available opportunities align, an internship may lead to a permanent role, though this is not guaranteed.

We are looking for 3-4 high-caliber Quantitative Analyst Interns to sit within our Linear Market Making, DeFi trading , Credit/curation and Corporate Development desks/teams (see other openings on our career page for details).

Application deadline: 30 November 2026
Start date: 1 March 2027

Selection process:

  • Interview with Talent Acquisition representative

  • Interview with Hiring Manager

  • Recruitment Challenge

 
 

The role

About Corporate Development
In our Corporate Development team, we identify, evaluate, prototype, and build strategic innovations across digital asset markets and Web3 ecosystems. Operating at the intersection of quantitative analysis, technology due diligence, and venture/strategic growth, the Corp Dev team works on evaluating emerging crypto primitives, building data-driven systems to track market trends, and assessing the technical viability of potential deals, partnerships, and new business lines. As an Innovation Quant Developer Intern, you will work directly with quant developers and Corp Dev strategists to prototype new technologies, conduct technical due diligence, and support strategic growth initiatives.

Key Responsibilities of an Innovation Quant Developer Intern in this unit

  • Web3 Primitive & Technology Evaluation: Assist in evaluating new Web3.0 primitives, DeFi protocols, and emerging blockchain infrastructure, analyzing engineering requirements to align with Corporate Development growth goals.

  • Technical Due Diligence & Strategic Analysis: Support technical and quantitative due diligence on potential strategic deals, venture investments, and ecosystem partnerships to evaluate architectural viability and strategic fit.

  • Prototyping & System Integration: Help build, test, and maintain prototype systems, analytics tools, and internal proof-of-concepts, collaborating across divisions to ensure compatibility with Keyrock's broader trading and tech stack.

  • Market Intelligence & Data Analytics: Use Python, SQL, and data analytics to track emerging technologies, monitor market trends, and deliver actionable data-driven insights for strategic growth opportunities.

Who You Are/Key Requirements

  • Technical & Quantitative Foundation: Graduating student or recent graduate in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance, or a related technical field with a solid code-first foundation in Python and SQL (with Git proficiency).

  • Web3 & Digital Asset Passion: Strong understanding of and active, deep interest in Web3.0, digital assets, blockchain primitives, and capital markets.

  • Analytical & Prototyping Mindset: Ability to analyze technical documentation, work with data/on-chain telemetry, evaluate emerging technologies, and build quantitative models or prototype tools.

  • Drive & Ownership: Self-starter with strong communication skills, curiosity to learn rapidly, and an owner mentality to contribute directly to strategic projects.

  • Nice-to-Haves: Hands-on experience prototyping smart contracts or Web3 tools, familiarity with Rust, Solidity, EVM event logs, or previous internship/project experience in crypto or quantitative finance.

Our offer

  • A 6 month paid internship at world-renowned digital assets company with accommodation provided for entirety or part of it

  • The opportunity to learn about digital assets and blockchain from a 30,000 ft view of the entire ecosystem

  • Working from one of Brussels newest, nicest and most advanced office spaces

  • A global, collaborative and tech-driven environment.

  • Autonomy & Impact - our flat structure means you can contribute your ideas from day one and help shape the foundation that will power Keyrock’s future business.

  • Culture of Excellence - we value nimbleness, drive for success, owner mentality and collaboration.

  • Opportunity to leave your mark and start your career in one of the most reputable companies in the digital assets world

  • We are envisioning for the internship to be based pre-dominantly in Brussels. It is possible for a selected candidate to be based in London, UK, provided at least 1-2 months onboarding period would be spent in Brussels together with the rest of the interns cohort.

 

Our recruitment philosophy

We value self-awareness and powerful communication skills in our recruitment process. We seek fiercely passionate people who understand themselves and their career goals. We're after those with the right skills and a conscious choice to join our field. The perfect fit? A crypto enthusiast who’s driven, collaborative, acts with ownership and delivers solid, scalable outcomes.

As an employer we are committed to building a positive and collaborative work environment. We welcome employees of all backgrounds, and hire, reward and promote entirely based on merit and performance.

Due to the nature of our business and external requirements, we perform background checks on all potential employees, passing which is a prerequisite to join Keyrock.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer has deployed data centers across multiple countries, including the United States, Norway, Bhutan, and Ethiopia. To learn more, visit https://ir.bitdeer.com

We are seeking

Bitdeer is seeking a Senior Commercial Contracts Manager to join our Legal & Compliance team in San Jose, CA. This individual will primarily focus on commercial contract operations — intake, execution discipline, recordkeeping, and obligation tracking — across Bitdeer’s North America construction, procurement, and site development activity. This is an operational and process-discipline role, not an attorney position.

What you will be responsible for

  • Serve as the single point of intake for commercial contracts across the North America function — vendor and supplier agreements, purchase orders, NDAs, membership-program paper, and routine amendments — and route each to the appropriate business and legal owner.
  • Build and own a central, searchable repository of executed agreements, capturing contract type, counterparty, effective and expiry dates, value, signatory, and status.
  • Administer the signature and execution workflow, confirming authorized signatories and a complete, correctly executed signature page before work begins or payment is released, and escalating exceptions immediately rather than after the fact.
  • Maintain a tracking calendar for renewal and auto-renewal windows, notice-to-terminate deadlines, insurance certificate expirations, and milestone and performance dates, and surface them to the responsible deal owner with enough lead time to act.
  • Own first-pass review and negotiation of standard agreement types against Bitdeer’s negotiation playbook and pre-approved fallback positions, escalating any requested deviation to the assigned attorney.
  • Evaluate and help implement a contract lifecycle management platform, and maintain the reporting that measures contract volume by type and business unit, cycle time, and workload.
  • Support the Legal & Compliance team on other contract operations matters as assigned.

How you will stand out

  • 8+ years in contracts management, contract administration, or legal operations. A law degree is not required for this role and is not a substitute for the experience described above.
  • Demonstrated experience building or substantially improving a contract intake, tracking, or repository process from a low-maturity starting point — this is a build, not a maintain-the-existing-system role.
  • Working fluency with a contract lifecycle management or e-signature platform (DocuSign, Ironclad, ContractPodAi, or equivalent), including comfort evaluating and selecting tools rather than only using them.
  • Strong, demonstrated process discipline and organizational rigor, with the judgment to operate within a playbook and escalation framework rather than deciding legal positions independently.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a collaborative mindset and high self-motivation.
  • Experience in a construction or EPC, energy, industrial procurement, or hardware and technology environment with high-volume deal flow.
  • Prior experience at a public company, with the recordkeeping and disclosure rigor that implies.
  • Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-jurisdiction operations across the United States and Canada.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Corporate Security Systems and Infrastructure (CSI) team safeguards Stripe’s people, offices, and operations by designing, delivering, and maintaining secure infrastructure across our global workplace portfolio. We take an intelligence-led, risk-based approach and partner closely with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, and external vendors to build reliable, scalable physical security systems and transition them to our Global Security Operations Center (GSOC) for ongoing monitoring and support.

What you’ll do

As a Corporate Security Infrastructure Project Manager, you will lead the security infrastructure workstream for new offices, expansions, relocations, and major workplace upgrades, with an initial focus on Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) and support for global projects as needed. You will manage projects from early site assessment and design through installation, testing, commissioning, and operational handover.

You will be accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder alignment across a portfolio of concurrent projects. In addition to delivering individual projects, you will strengthen the CSI program by improving standards, documentation, vendor performance, reporting, and repeatable project management processes. You will work through ambiguity, surface decisions early, and communicate clearly with technical teams, business partners, vendors, and senior leaders.

Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of security infrastructure for office construction and expansion projects, from site assessment and requirements definition through design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
  • Lead requests for proposals (RFPs) for security installations, including defining scope and requirements, coordinating bidders, reviewing submissions, evaluating proposals with relevant stakeholders, and supporting vendor selection recommendations.
  • Own project scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, decisions, and change control; provide clear, outcome-focused reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Coordinate security designs and technical requirements with Workplace, IT, Security Operations, Legal, architects, general contractors, landlords, and other project partners.
  • Review design drawings, specifications, bills of materials, and implementation plans to ensure alignment with CSI standards and local requirements.
  • Manage security integrators, consultants, and contractors, including statements of work, delivery milestones, quality expectations, service levels, and performance reviews.
  • Oversee system installation, acceptance testing, commissioning, punch-list resolution, documentation, and first-day-of-business readiness.
  • Ensure completed projects are smoothly handed over to the GSOC and support teams, with accurate system records, operating procedures, training, and ownership established.
  • Maintain and improve global construction standards, technical specifications, project templates, runbooks, and closeout documentation.
  • Develop and track project health metrics, vendor KPIs, budget forecasts, and lessons learned; use insights to improve delivery quality, predictability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support new market and site evaluations by identifying security risks, infrastructure constraints, integration needs, and mitigation options.
  • Support the security repair and maintenance program, with a focus on the EMEA region, collaborating with regional teams to triage, track, and resolve security system and hardware issues.
  • Partner with CSI engineers and program leadership to prioritize work, resolve cross-project dependencies, and scale consistent processes across the portfolio.
  • Travel up to 25%, including international travel, to support site assessments, project milestones, commissioning, and handover.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 5+ years of project management experience delivering complex physical security, workplace technology, low-voltage, construction, or similarly technical infrastructure projects.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent projects across the full lifecycle, with ownership of scope, schedule, budget, risk, quality, and stakeholder communication.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional delivery among technical teams, business partners, design and construction teams, vendors, and senior leaders.
  • Strong vendor and contractor management skills, including defining requirements, managing contracts or statements of work, tracking delivery, and addressing performance issues.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical details into clear decisions, risks, tradeoffs, and next steps for different audiences.
  • Strong judgment and structured problem-solving skills; able to operate independently, navigate ambiguity, anticipate issues, and drive timely decisions.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and a demonstrated commitment to accurate documentation, standards, and operational handoffs.
  • Experience establishing project management processes, tracking performance metrics, and applying lessons learned to improve future delivery.
  • Working knowledge of physical security systems such as access control, video management, intrusion detection, intercoms, low-voltage infrastructure, and door hardware.
  • Ability to travel internationally up to 25%.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience delivering security infrastructure for offices in multiple countries or regions, particularly in EMEA.
  • Experience with Genetec Security Center, including Synergis, Omnicast, Security Center SaaS, or Stratocast; active Genetec certification is a plus.
  • Familiarity with system integrations, networking fundamentals, APIs, webhooks, or cloud-managed security technologies.
  • Experience managing budgets, forecasts, vendor KPIs, SLAs, and portfolio-level reporting.
  • Experience using project management and workflow tools such as Jira and Smartsheet.
  • Experience reviewing and marking up construction and security design documentation using Bluebeam Revu or a similar PDF design-review tool, along with knowledge of commissioning practices and relevant local codes or regulatory requirements.
  • A bachelor’s degree in project management, construction management, security management, information technology, engineering, or a related field; or a relevant professional certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, ASIS PSP/CPP, or SIA CSPM.
  • Ability to select and use appropriate AI tools to improve work, while critically evaluating and refining outputs for accuracy and quality.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by technology. Founded in 2017, we are revolutionising world systems through our cutting-edge digital asset exchange, Web3 portal and blockchain ecosystems. We reshape the financial ecosystem by offering some of the most diverse and sophisticated products, solutions, and trading tools on the market. Trusted by more than 50 million users in 180 countries globally, OKX empowers every individual to explore the world of Web3. With our extensive range of products and services, and unwavering commitment to security and reliability, we provide an essential trading platform for the world's investors and institutions. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. As strong believers in the value of blockchain technology, we are committed to building a more inclusive and open financial future and we know that starts with the people who build it.
 

About the team

OKX's Global Legal team provides legal advice and guidance to OKX and its affiliated entities across all coverage areas and geographic locations, and supports business growth by working with all teams within the company to help them achieve their goals. We are a high-functioning, collaborative and fast-paced team who enjoys the cutting-edge nature of our work and our industry. Our team of 60+ lawyers are located around the world, and the OKX Chief Legal Officer is based in the United States.
 

About the opportunity

As Deputy General Counsel and Head of Legal, UK, you will lead the UK legal function, working closely with the UK CEO and other key UK stakeholders and reporting into the Global Legal team. You will provide strategic legal advice to the UK business and work closely with global legal colleagues and senior business leaders on regulatory, commercial and strategic matters.
 
You will be a member of the UK management team and represent the legal function at relevant Board and committee meetings.
 
The right candidate will have direct legal experience and an enthusiastic belief in the digital asset space, 14+ years of experience working for a top-tier law firm, in-house at a financial services or digital assets company or with a financial services regulator and possess excellent writing and analytical skills. The ideal candidate has deep experience in financial services and digital asset regulation, U.K. licensing, marketing and advertising, and contract law.
 
We offer a competitive base salary and bonus structure as well as excellent benefits and an opportunity to work in a cutting-edge industry that will be the future of financial services.
 

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Supporting OKX's business expansion into the United Kingdom. This role will be the primary legal point of contact for the OKX U.K. entity, and will be called upon to support the business in its licensing and legal efforts to expand into the U.K. Market. The right candidate will also have experience in government and regulatory relations and will be responsible for ensuring OKX is a valued contributor to the developing legal frameworks in the sector. This will include representing OKX in relevant industry associations and promoting OKX's view point in consultation efforts.
  • Supporting the business in virtually all legal coverage areas, including but not limited to product development, regulatory matters, IP and trademark enforcement, corporate governance, licensing efforts, token listings for OKX U.K., contract negotiation, compliance legal support, institutional sales and partnerships, and marketing and advertising;
  • Analyzing and advising on the legal risk of new and existing digital assets and managing the legal component of the new asset review process;
  • Collaborating with product and business development teams to achieve company-wide projects and goals; and
  • Managing legal requests from all areas of the business and effectively advising on legal concepts and legal risk with an eye towards the strategic goals of business leaders.
  • You will be working from OKX's London office three days a week. You may work remotely two days a week.

What We Look For In You

  • Law degree at a top-tier law school and qualified to practice law in the U.K.
  • 14+ years of legal experience at a top-tier law firm and/or in-house legal team, preferably in the cryptocurrency/digital assets and/or financial services industry.
  • Experience advising on digital asset and blockchain technology legal issues and have a basic understanding of the relevant legal and regulatory landscape.
  • Experience working with the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and obtaining U.K. financial services and/or crypto exchange licenses.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, growth-stage and multi-cultural environment.
  • Ability to effectively advise and build trust with business teams.
  • Ability to navigate through a rapidly-changing legal landscape and deal with legal ambiguity.
  • Ability to work in a high-functioning legal team and feel comfortable in a collaborative working environment.
  • Self-starter, quick learner who is highly driven, proactive, responsive and precise.
  • Experience working on cross-jurisdictional matters and a global legal team.

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
